entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is David, you're speaking with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is 774-B-91.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... 774-B-91... I see it. This is for the Velocity Pro cycling shoes, delivered 37 days ago. Is that correct?
That's it. I need to send them back.
I can certainly look into that. Just for my notes, what was the issue with the shoes?
The fit is all wrong. I adjusted the cleats multiple times, but after one ride they gave me terrible blisters. I just need a refund.
I'm sorry to hear they caused you trouble. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item.
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return them or not?
Yes, you can. The delivery was 37 days ago, and these shoes fall under our 90-day return policy. You are well within the window. I've just initiated the return in our system.
Okay, good. So what happens now?

I've sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the cycling shoes, your full refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
